column2: SELECT subscription_group, node, address, expires_at, groups FROM wow_lease_member WHERE subscription_group = $1 AND expires_at > $2 ORDER BY node
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "wow_failure_ledger" WHERE service = $1 AND subscription_context = $2 AND subscription = $3 LIMIT $4) AS parked
SELECT subscription_group, partition, owner, epoch, expires_at FROM wow_lease WHERE subscription_group = $1 AND expires_at > $2 ORDER BY partition
SELECT count(*) AS registered, NULL::integer AS branch, NULL::text AS timer_id FROM wow_timer_aggregate WHERE context = $1

INSERT INTO wow_lease_member (subscription_group, node, address, expires_at, groups) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (subscription_group, node) DO UPDATE SET address = excluded.address, expires_at = excluded.expires_at, groups = excluded.groups

SELECT * FROM "wow_failure_ledger" WHERE service = $1 AND subscription_context = $2 AND subscription = $3 AND partition = ANY ($4) AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= $5) ORDER BY context, aggregate_name, tenant_id, aggregate_id LIMIT $6
SELECT revision, rebuilding, backfilled, fill FROM wow_snapshot_table WHERE structure = $1
UPDATE wow_lease SET expires_at = $1 WHERE subscription_group = $2 AND owner = $3 AND partition = ANY($4) AND expires_at > $5 RETURNING subscription_group, partition, owner, epoch, expires_at
DELETE FROM wow_lease_member WHERE subscription_group = $1 AND expires_at < $2
SELECT partition, sequence FROM "wow_log__transfer__partition" WHERE partition = ANY($1)
SELECT aggregate FROM wow_log_aggregate WHERE context = $1 ORDER BY aggregate
